recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male figure in a dark shirt against a heavily textured, industrial wall. The aesthetic is defined by a desaturated, earthy color palette, high-contrast lighting, and a distressed, 'dirty' frame that mimics aged film or weathered paper.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left against a vertical divide in the background
Typography anchored in the upper right quadrant within the darker negative space
Texture of the background wall mirrored in the distressed treatment of the lettering
High contrast between the subject's pale skin and the deep shadows of the clothing and background
coreInvariants: High-contrast, dramatic lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, highlighted by a strong key light, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, moves down the dark silhouette of the shirt, then travels right to the textured typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space on the right side provides a canvas for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (shadows and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted beige and ochre (background wall and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Restricted to earth tones, blacks, and greys

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges mimicking stone or weathered metal
Internal texture showing cracks and peeling paint effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs feature irregular 'bites' taken out of the strokes to enhance the distressed look

composition.relationshipToImage: Clean contrast to distressed main title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed, large-scale display type paired with a smaller, cleaner, wide-tracked subtitle for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Classic condensed sans-serif that takes texture well.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with brown hair in a black button-down shirt, standing against a weathered, industrial concrete wall with peeling paint and rust stains. Use high-contrast lighting with deep shadows. Apply a desaturated earth-tone color grade and a distressed, irregular dark border frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed, uppercase sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant. Apply a heavy cracked/eroded texture to the main title. Below it, add a smaller subtitle in a clean, wide-tracked condensed sans-serif in a muted ochre color.

verificationChecks: Is the border frame irregular and distressed?
Does the main title have a visible 'cracked' texture?
Is the color palette restricted to desaturated earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Level of erosion on the typography
Warmth vs. coolness of the earth tones
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text texture matches the background grit
Check that the vignette doesn't obscure the subject's face
Verify the border looks like physical wear, not a digital filter
Confirm the hierarchy between the two text elements is clear
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Portrait + Distressed Typography + Earth Tone Grading + Weathered Frame
